summary.text: Jason Moore is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 13, running against incumbent Republican Celeste Cairns in the November 3, 2026 general election.

An insurance agency owner, he says in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities include home insurance reform, education, and support for military families and small businesses, including commercial fishing.

paragraphs.text: Moore earned a high school diploma from Person High School and a bachelor's degree from North Carolina State University in 2001.
In a Ballotpedia survey he said he is a lifelong North Carolinian and the son of a veteran, farmer and teacher, and that he coaches in a little league.
He described his career as spanning business, agriculture and public policy, and said he has spent two decades in the insurance field.
Moore said he is running because homeowners insurance costs for coastal families in Carteret and Craven Counties have risen sharply, and that he wants to take on home insurance reform.
